decisions.problem: Owner-recorded portal identities were duplicated across several current Control Center surfaces and could drift between releases.
decisions.evidence: v1.7.55 was current for Smarter Justice while Estate, Personal Injury and Domestic Violence had newer authoritative artifacts in their dedicated build contexts.
decisions.expectedBenefit: One deterministic validation exposes any version, filename, hash, size or evidence-state disagreement before release.
decisions.acceptanceTest: The new currentness module validates all four portal identities across the current truth, artifact registry, evidence-state register, release snapshot and operating-system seed.

decisions.idea: Restyle or expand the public Attorney Partner Tour
decisions.problem: No material public presentation defect was found.
decisions.evidence: The complete baseline passed and the high-value public route hashes remain unchanged.
decisions.expectedBenefit: None sufficient to justify visual churn.
decisions.reason: No changes for the sake of changes.
